dateRule: ECHO MonitoringPeriodEndDate DD-MON-YY normalized to ISO (%y 15-26 map to 2015-2026); null stays null, never 0
geography: Cushing city, Oklahoma (ECHO CWPCity=CUSHING, state OK)
label: Cushing city ECHO DMR effluent flow quantities, dated, not last-inspection counts, not busy
notJoined: CWA last-inspection counts (091-CWAZ rows not copied)
nullValueRule: DMRValueNmbr null (always with NODI, e.g. C No Discharge) stays empty, never 0; valued rows keep filed units (MGD, gal/d, or null as filed)
parameterDesc: Flow, in conduit or thru treatment plant
sourceName: EPA ECHO effluent charts REST (eff_rest_services, keyless) with explicit start_date/end_date
windowingNote: Omitting start_date/end_date returns only the current permit window; the explicit 01/01/2015-09/09/2026 range routes the same call to real historical DMR data
